$Comment: The Full Table: the season's capstone, earned the moment every achievement tagged full_table in the
Seasons > Harvest_Feast subcategory is earned in the same year. MetaSelector picks them, so a new
full_table achievement counts toward it with no edit here; it never picks itself or another
capstone. It inherits the yearly occurrence, so each year has its own copy, and it pays the title
Harvest_Feast_Full_Table through the Title reward kind. Keep the full_table tag off this file.
Each year's copy also hands over MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Boost_Token: half again as much XP in every
skill for an hour, which the player starts when it suits them. It is kept with their skills, not in
the bag, so it pays in Auto. Its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on
a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the title still pays.
